evaluations.query: local dev server with live reload for static html css js
evaluations.reason: All three methods include live-server or its forks. Method A is best because it also recommends browser-sync and @web/dev-server as diverse, useful alternatives. Method B and C mostly recommend forks of live-server (@compodoc/live-server, @pattern-lab/live-server) with little variety, and C has a duplicate entry.

evaluations.query: browser automation testing framework javascript webdriver
evaluations.reason: Method A includes selenium-webdriver, @wdio/cli, and the GT nightwatch — a perfect set. Method B has selenium-webdriver but then drifts to webdriver-manager and a lighthouse service. Method C recommends obscure packages like @midscene/webdriver and a generic cucumber framework.

evaluations.query: javascript math library for matrix operations and coordinate transformations
evaluations.reason: None of the methods recommend the GT @loaders.gl/math. However, Method A recommends mathjs, @thi.ng/matrices, and rematrix which are all highly relevant. Method C also recommends rematrix, @thi.ng/matrices, and wgpu-matrix. Method B's recommendations are less well-known (math3d, matrixops).

evaluations.query: safely parse and evaluate math expressions from user input in javascript
evaluations.reason: None include the GT @sideway/formula, but all recommend relevant expression parsers. Method A's mathjs and expr-eval are well-established and widely used. Method C's decimal-eval and math-expression-evaluator are also solid. Method B's @emmetio/math-expression is more niche.

evaluations.query: phone number input with country code formatting and validation js
evaluations.reason: Method B places GT intl-tel-input at rank 1, plus libphonenumber-js which is also excellent. Method A recommends country-code-splitter and a React-specific component, partially relevant. Method C recommends only Angular Material packages, not useful for a general JS project.

evaluations.query: javascript diff library to compare two text strings and show changes
evaluations.reason: Both A and B place GT diff at rank 1. Method B adds disparity (colorized diff) which is very useful for the text editor use case. Method A's other two are generic diff algorithms. Method C drifts to lcov-comparer and css-diff which are less relevant to general text diffing.
